ReservationPage.title: Request a reservation with a preview-first flow.
ReservationPage.description: This shell collects reservation details, offers an advisory availability preview, and submits a typed request through the service layer.
ReservationPage.previewDescription: Preview results are advisory only. Final confirmation and conflict checks remain backend-owned.
ReservationPage.previewError: The preview request could not be completed.
ReservationPage.previewIdle: Choose a date and guest count, then request preview availability.
ReservationPage.previewUnavailable: No preview time slots were returned.
ReservationPage.timeSlotPlaceholder: Preview time slots will appear here after you request availability.
ReservationPage.specialRequestHint: Optional notes are helpful, but final accommodation depends on backend confirmation.
ReservationPage.submitError: The reservation request could not be completed.
ReservationPage.sidebarDescription: The frontend gathers intent and clearly separates advisory preview data from final backend confirmation.
ReservationPage.confirmationDescription: A successful frontend submit still represents a request. The backend remains the final authority for reservation confirmation, conflicts, and timing.

CartPage.title: Review shared cart state before checkout.
CartPage.description: This shell reads directly from the existing cart store and keeps pricing intentionally non-authoritative until menu integration lands.
CartPage.emptyDescription: That is expected in this shell phase because menu integration has not been built yet.
CartPage.integrationNote: Once menu pages connect to the cart store, selected items will appear here with richer product details.
CartPage.pricingNote: Pricing remains a preview concern for now. Final totals, taxes, and delivery fees stay backend-authoritative.

CheckoutPage.title: Submit an order request without claiming final pricing authority.
CheckoutPage.description: This shell validates customer input with Zod and react-hook-form, maps values into the service layer, and keeps final order acceptance, fees, and payment state with the backend.
CheckoutPage.emptyTitle: Checkout needs at least one cart item.
CheckoutPage.emptyDescription: Use the cart shell first. Menu integration will populate it later.
CheckoutPage.emptyError: Add at least one item to the cart before submitting checkout.
CheckoutPage.submitError: The order request could not be completed.
CheckoutPage.estimatedDescription: This shell does not claim final backend pricing authority. Any preview total returned after submit is still advisory until the backend confirms the order.
